run_main: run the malaria fake data generator to create Parasitized and Uninfected image folders
create_folder: create a folder with fake malaria cell images using the create_folder function
run_main_with_tfds_dir: run the malaria generator with a custom tfds_dir flag pointing to the tensorflow_datasets directory
create_folder_parasitized: create the Parasitized folder with 2 random 300x300 PNG images for malaria dataset testing
create_folder_uninfected: create the Uninfected folder with 2 random 300x300 PNG images for malaria dataset testing
